procedures.title: Confined-space entry: tank, chamber and wet-well work

steps.text: Review the risk assessment and entry plan with every member of the entry team
Isolate and lock out every inlet, outlet and mechanical drive, then verify the isolation
Ventilate the space and test the atmosphere for oxygen, flammable gas, hydrogen sulphide and carbon monoxide
Enter with a standby person at the opening and rescue gear in place
Carry out the work, re-testing the atmosphere at every break
Leave the space, count everyone out and close the entry permit

procedures.title: Hot work: cutting, welding and grinding near plant

steps.text: Clear the area and remove combustibles within 10 m
Isolate the equipment and confirm it is de-energised before any work starts
Confirm the hot-work permit is open and post a fire watch with an extinguisher
Keep the fire watch for 60 minutes after the work stops
Close the permit and record the area as clear

reports.title: Clarifier 4 refurbishment: progress report, week ending 2 Oct 2026
reports.summary: Mobilisation is complete and the clarifier is isolated and drained. The programme is on track.
reports.progress: The access scaffold is erected and certified. The scraper drive isolation is applied and the permit to work is open.
reports.safety: Site induction done for all contractor staff. No incidents or near misses.
reports.next: Remove the scraper arms and the drive head.

reports.title: Clarifier 4 refurbishment: progress report, week ending 9 Oct 2026
reports.summary: The scraper arms and drive are out. The contractor claimed the milestone on 8 October and the works engineer has not confirmed it yet.
reports.progress: Both scraper arms and the drive head are on the laydown area. The gearbox oil seal leaked on removal and is logged as an issue.
reports.safety: A lifting plan was written for the drive head. One near miss: an unsecured guard rail on the scaffold, fixed the same day.
reports.next: Strip the slewing ring and measure the bearing wear for the replacement order.

reports.title: Raw-water main replacement: progress report, week ending 20 Sep 2026
reports.summary: The bypass barrel is in and being pressure tested. Work is on programme.
reports.progress: The bypass barrel is laid between the two valve chambers and the tie-ins are made.
reports.safety: Trench shoring checked daily. No incidents.
reports.next: Commission the bypass barrel and swing the flow across.

reports.title: Raw-water main replacement: progress report, week ending 27 Sep 2026
reports.summary: The bypass barrel is commissioned and the main is off. Section 1 excavation has started.
reports.progress: Intake is running at 100 ML/d through the bypass barrel. Excavation of section 1 is about half done.
reports.safety: A trench wall slipped in loose ground and no one was in the excavation. The shoring was upgraded.
reports.next: Complete the section 1 excavation and start laying new pipe.

reports.title: Raw-water main replacement: progress report, week ending 4 Oct 2026
reports.summary: Section 1 pipe laying is slower than planned because of rock in the trench line.
reports.progress: About 60 m of new pipe is laid in section 1. The pressure test is not yet done.
reports.safety: No incidents. The valve-chamber entry plan is under review before the chamber work starts.
reports.next: Finish laying section 1 and agree the pressure test date.

reports.title: RES-2 relining: progress report, week ending 25 Sep 2026
reports.summary: Cell B is drained, cleaned and signed off for stripping.
reports.progress: Sludge and silt are out of cell B. The old lining shows blistering over about a third of the floor.
reports.safety: Every entry was made under a confined-space permit with a standby person. No incidents.

reports.title: RES-2 relining: progress report, week ending 2 Oct 2026
reports.summary: The old lining is stripped, on the milestone date.
reports.progress: The floor and walls are stripped to the substrate and blasted. Concrete repairs have started.
reports.safety: Dust control at the access hatch was improved after a monitor reading. No injuries.
reports.next: Complete the concrete repairs and start laying the new liner.

reports.title: RES-2 relining: progress report, week ending 9 Oct 2026
reports.summary: Liner installation is under way. One seam test failed and is being re-welded.
reports.progress: About 70 percent of the floor liner is down. Panel 14 failed its seam test.
reports.safety: The entry permit for cell B was renewed to 13 October. The crew is working long days to recover the programme.
reports.next: Re-weld panel 14 and start the wall liner. Renew the entry permit.

evidence.title: Calibration certificate, four-gas atmosphere monitor

reports.title: Filter media replacement: progress report, week ending 9 Oct 2026
reports.summary: F01 is out of service and emptied. The old media is being removed.
reports.progress: F01 is drained and about half of the old media is out. The underdrain nozzles are inspected.
reports.safety: Dust masks are used for all media handling. No incidents.
reports.next: Finish removing the old media and check the nozzles.

reports.title: Filter media replacement: progress report, week ending 13 Oct 2026
reports.summary: F01 is clean and the underdrain is checked. New media is due on site next week.
reports.progress: Four underdrain nozzles were replaced. The new media delivery is booked for 16 October.
reports.safety: Housekeeping in the filter gallery is good. No incidents.
reports.next: Receive and place the new media in F01 and start the backwash commissioning.
